initial_state.tagline: A simulated home-sharing site. Every host, listing, rating and reservation here is invented; nothing is booked and nothing is charged.

cabin-skykomish-aframe.title: Riverside A-frame with wood stove - Skykomish, WA
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, 2 dogs welcome
cabin-skykomish-aframe.description: Price per night. A 1972 A-frame on the Skykomish river with a wood stove, a sauna and a deck over the water. Cell signal is weak; the wifi is Starlink and fine for calls. Check-in 16:00, check-out 11:00, quiet hours from 22:00. Cleaning fee $95.

cabin-hood-canal.title: Cedar cabin on Hood Canal with oyster beach
bullets: House rules: no parties, one small dog by arrangement
cabin-hood-canal.description: Price per night. Small cedar cabin above a beach where you can pick oysters at low tide (bring a licence and a knife; the host leaves a guide). Wood stove, outdoor shower, no TV. Cleaning fee $70.

beach-cannon-beach-house.title: Oceanfront house with Haystack Rock view - Cannon Beach, OR
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, dogs welcome, 3-night minimum
beach-cannon-beach-house.description: Price per night. Three-storey cedar-shingle house directly on the sand, with the rock in the middle window. Big kitchen, two decks, a fire pit and a garage full of beach chairs. Cleaning fee $250.

beach-kauai-studio.title: Beachfront studio with lanai - Kapaa, Kauai
bullets: House rules: no smoking, no pets, quiet hours 21:00
Snorkel gear and beach cruisers included
beach-kauai-studio.description: Price per night. Ground-floor studio opening straight onto the lanai and the sand. Kitchenette, outdoor shower, two bikes and a box of snorkel gear. The coastal bike path passes the gate. Cleaning fee $110.

beach-outer-banks-cottage.title: Oceanside cottage with hot tub - Nags Head, NC
bullets: House rules: no parties, one dog under 40 lb, 7-night minimum in July and August
beach-outer-banks-cottage.description: Price per night. Raised cottage on the oceanfront row with a screened porch, hot tub under the house and a private walkway over the dune. Linens provided; beach permits for driving on the sand are on the fridge. Cleaning fee $200.

city-capitol-hill-loft.title: Bright loft with rooftop deck - Capitol Hill, Seattle
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, no pets, quiet hours from 22:00
city-capitol-hill-loft.description: Price per night. Top-floor loft in a converted 1920s warehouse with a shared rooftop deck and a view of the Space Needle. Desk, fast wifi, and the light rail two blocks away. Cleaning fee $60.

city-lisbon-alfama.title: Tiled apartment with river view - Alfama, Lisbon
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, quiet hours 23:00-08:00
city-lisbon-alfama.description: Price per night. Azulejo-tiled one-bedroom with a small balcony over the river and the fado bars three streets down. Ines leaves a bottle of vinho verde and a list of the places locals eat. Cleaning fee $45.

city-brooklyn-garden.title: Garden apartment in a brownstone - Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, one cat lives upstairs
city-brooklyn-garden.description: Price per night. Garden level of an owner-occupied brownstone with its own entrance, a full kitchen and the backyard. A train four minutes away. Manhattan in 25 minutes. Cleaning fee $90.

city-mexico-roma.title: Art deco apartment with terrace - Roma Norte, Mexico City
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking indoors, quiet hours 22:00
city-mexico-roma.description: Price per night. Second-floor 1930s apartment with original parquet, a plant-filled terrace and a desk that faces it. Filtered water, good coffee, and the market on Sundays at the end of the street. Cleaning fee $35.

tree-olympic-canopy.title: Treehouse in the canopy with a rope bridge - Olympic Peninsula, WA
bullets: House rules: adults only, no pets, no smoking, no drones
tree-olympic-canopy.description: Price per night. Cedar treehouse eleven metres up in a second-growth forest, reached by a rope bridge from the hillside. Composting toilet, hot outdoor shower on the ground, a bed under a skylight. Cleaning fee $80.

tree-blue-ridge.title: Treehouse with a claw-foot tub - Asheville, NC
bullets: House rules: no children under 12, no pets, no parties
Wood-fired hot tub on the deck
tree-blue-ridge.description: Price per night. Treehouse in the oaks above a creek with a claw-foot tub inside and a wood-fired hot tub on the deck. Breakfast basket delivered to the foot of the stairs at 8:30. Cleaning fee $75.

tree-costa-rica-jungle.title: Open-air jungle treehouse - Nosara, Costa Rica
bullets: House rules: no smoking, no parties, keep food sealed (monkeys)
tree-costa-rica-jungle.description: Price per night. Screened, open-sided treehouse with a mosquito-netted bed, a hammock and howler monkeys at dawn whether you want them or not. Surf beach is a fifteen-minute walk. Cleaning fee $40.

tiny-vashon-cabin.title: Tiny house in an orchard - Vashon Island, WA
bullets: House rules: no parties, no pets, ferry schedule on the fridge
tiny-vashon-cabin.description: Price per night. 24-foot tiny house on wheels in a working apple orchard, with a sleeping loft, a compact kitchen and a deck facing the trees. Fresh eggs from the coop by the gate. Cleaning fee $50.

tiny-joshua-tree.title: Off-grid tiny home with outdoor tub - Joshua Tree, CA
bullets: House rules: no parties, no smoking, no pets, 2-night minimum
Solar power, rainwater, no light pollution
tiny-joshua-tree.description: Price per night. Solar-powered tiny home on five acres of high desert with a soaking tub under the stars and a telescope on the deck. Nearest shop is twenty minutes; bring groceries. Cleaning fee $65.

tiny-vermont-hut.title: Modern tiny cabin on a hillside - Stowe, VT
bullets: House rules: no smoking, dogs welcome, quiet hours from 21:00
tiny-vermont-hut.description: Price per night. Black-clad tiny cabin with a wall of glass facing the valley, a wood stove and a queen bed. Five minutes to the ski lifts, forty minutes to Burlington. Cleaning fee $55.
